definitions.gloss: somehow; vaguely; in some indefinable way
definitions.explanation: Expresses a feeling or impression that is hard to pinpoint or articulate clearly. The speaker senses something but cannot identify exactly what or why.

examples.japanese: どことなく⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どことなく⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧。
examples.english: Those two somehow resemble each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どことなく⟦{元気|げんき}がない→元気がない：19488_genkiganai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧みた。
examples.english: He seemed somehow lacking in energy today, so I tried talking to him.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally 'from no particular place.' Often modifies adjectives and verbs of perception. Conveys a subtle, intuitive impression rather than a clear observation. Common in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どことなく⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧ (somehow resembling)
- どことなく⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧ (somehow lonely)
- どことなく⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧ (somehow nostalgic)
- どことなく⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧な (somehow uneasy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なんとなく: somehow, for no particular reason — very similar but slightly more casual; often implies doing something without clear intent
- ⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧: somewhere; in some way — can overlap in meaning but is broader in usage
